summary: Iteration 3 testing (Pixel Lab rebranding + theme switcher + label print dialog fix). Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass — GET/PUT /api/settings persists platform_name and theme (quantum/emerald/cyber), tecnico PUT -> 403, invalid theme -> 422, /api/public/settings exposes platform_name & theme without auth. Frontend: admin login renders dashboard with 'PIXEL LAB' sidebar badge; /settings shows 'Branding & Tema' section with settings-platform-name input and theme-quantum/emerald/cyber cards. Changing theme to emerald sets html[data-theme=emerald] and --eds-bg to #0a1f1a; renaming platform_name updates sidebar badge immediately. Reload persists theme=emerald. Reset back to quantum works. Tickets print flow verified: action-print-label-{code} opens dialog with 3 label-layout buttons WITHOUT calling window.print; after choosing std, html gains class 'print-mode-label', .print-root-label is injected into DOM and window.print() is invoked while class is active; cleanup removes class after ~500ms. action-print-a4-{code} analogously adds 'print-mode-a4' and injects .print-root-a4 before window.print — this verifies the fix for the blank-page bug via isolated @media print visibility rules.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: @app.on_event startup/shutdown are deprecated in FastAPI — consider lifespan context manager (non-blocking).
GET /api/settings auto-inserts default doc when missing — this is fine but note the doc includes 'id' field returned to client (minor info leak of singleton key).
TicketsPage.triggerPrint relies on fixed 150ms/500ms timeouts; if printers / browsers delay, class may be removed before print renders — acceptable but could use onafterprint listener.
